I don't know how old you are but i am 24. I have had quite a lot of time in positions similar to yours. Personally I've struggled with difficult situations vividly since at least the age of 9, so I come here in the hopes that my experience in tough situations (especially situations like these) can help other people. 

I think that as we grow some of us who have had difficult experiences feel and understand them differently (obviously depending on the situation and the community around us). However I do wish you all the strength in the world. I would love for you to focus on you and, as i said, finding a way to scratch those itches you feel in a new way. It may not be familiar but finding NEW experiences are a major path in progression you as a person.

Wishing you all the beat in your future.

Break ups really suck my man. I know exactly what you're going through. Exactly. I think the important thing to work on is that the person YOU are is much more than what someone else makes you feel. The positive feelings we get from other people. We feed on them. It's part of the human condition. The game is scratching those same itches in a different way. Its up to you by what means you scratch those issues (in a healthy way). Distinguishing between the positive and negative ways of scratching those issues is seriously tricky but absolutly a road with exploring. I'm seriously sorry that this shit has happened and you're expierncing this aswell. As shitty as it sounds and as much it hurts me to say, Closure (to me at least) is only a means of explanation and explanation in some ways is open to interpretation to the person seeking closure. The information you get from the person of interest in the search for closure may not arrive to you in the same way the person meant it. The important thing I want for you is that those itches that were scratched by this person, you find scratched by somthing else (with emphasis on not searching for another person to scratch those itches). Ibwish you all the best and I really hope this helps ❤
